in Ordinary Time October 11 2026 Thank you to all those who helped with our annual parish picnic this past weekend From Michelle in our parish office helping to organize food and games to Stacey and Rick organizing setup to volunteers from Credo Homeschooling setting up tables and chairs to all those who helped with cleanup With around 175 in attendance I think this was one of our best picnics yet We look forward to continuing to grow this great annual event special Thank You to our Knights of Columbus for their help in preparing our sanctuary for reopening This past Thursday a number of our Knights helped to carry the sanctuary furniture and statues all scattered in storage areas throughout our campus back into the church And thanks to the steady hand of Knight Dan Geimer the lettering on our Stations of the Cross are now gilded and readable under the new station lights St Joseph Giving Table Thank You Another special Thank You to all those who supported the St Joseph Giving Table throughout this past summer and fall It's always a great joy to be able to share an abundance of the fruits of our labors with our parish family With the colder weather beginning to roll in we've wrapped up the St Joseph Giving Table for the year Please continue to keep our farmers in your prayers during this harvest season Schedule Change No Weekday Masses October 12th 17th Next week I hope to join my brother priests for our annual Continuing Education Days This time together is not only about growing in knowledge but also about gathering for priestly fraternity This year we are focusing on mental health awareness for priestly ministry This includes both practical scenarios encountered in priestly ministry and a greater self awareness of our own mental health for healthy and fulfilling priestly ministry Due to this mandatory week away for all priests in parishes throughout our diocese we will not be able to offer our regular daily Mass Adoration or Confession schedule this coming week Oct12 th 17th Our normal daily Mass schedule will resume the following week Oct 19th 24th Our weekend Mass schedule remains as always unchanged Infant and Pregnancy Loss Memorial Prayer Service Since 1998 the Sunday closest to October 15th has been nationally observed as the annual Day for Pregnancy and Infant Loss Remembrance Keeping with this day of prayer we will hold a prayer service to remember and support those affected by pregnancy and infant loss This Memorial Prayer Service will be on Sunday October 18th at St Joseph Catholic Cemetery at 2 PM This service is open to parishioners and all throughout Wells County The prayer service includes the opportunity to place memorial butterfly ornaments at the cemetery These memorial butterfly ornaments will be available in the narthex at both of our local funeral homes throughout this coming week and at the cemetery the day of the prayer service Those who may not be ready to attend a public service are invited to take and place their own butterfly ornaments at the cemetery privately Liturgical and Altar Arrangements As mentioned in recent weeks with our return to the sanctuary we will be adopting some of the variety of liturgical options that the Church offers us Most visible will be the use of differing altar arrangements in our regular schedule Our Friday 8:30AM and Sunday 10 AM Masses will be celebrated ad orientem with priest and people facing together while our other seven daily and weekend Masses will be celebrated versus populum with the priest facing the congregation Having made use of both options during renovations this seems an opportune time to adopt both into our regular schedule allowing for differing options as we join together in our one worship of Christ Saturday
